layout: Retain the rust/ workspace prefix during extraction so embedded relative paths and Python ROOT contracts stay unchanged. No sibling checkouts are included.

groups.consumer: Cargo build; game service; JSON-lines worker
required_external_inputs: pinned compiler and Rust registry dependencies from Cargo.lock
explicit admitted runtime content pack or private checkpoint/database for running games
Python 3.11+ standard library tooling and independent requirements.lock for tests
optional full fixture cache only for selected full/restore gates

groups.destination: same path; oracle sources acquired independently
groups.consumer: optional Python exporters; source/runtime hashes must match oracle-manifest.json
required_external_inputs: exact admitted oracle source artifact and frozen runtime
full parity/cache data for selected exporters/comparisons
explicit compatible Python service for hosted/replay-share tools
optional explicit Lab source/evaluator only for those selected workflows
built Linux game binary and admitted content
selected systemd host and explicit frontend/Rust origins for deployed checks
release identity manifest and caller-provided ingress credentials
compatible Python service only for hosted adapter verification

groups.consumer: provenance and original milestone records, not active contributor instructions
required_external_inputs: original repository Git provenance only when refreshing historical inventory; static records require none

excluded.reason: original history/Python engine/private or generated material; never copied by extraction
Full payloads acquired into configurable ignored cache; smoke is explicitly retained by its own group

external_dependencies.name: compiler
external_dependencies.contract: Rust 1.99.1 with rustfmt/clippy; Linux validated; C compiler for bundled SQLite

external_dependencies.name: oracle
external_dependencies.contract: Exact files/runtime from rust/oracle-manifest.json; GOA2_ORACLE_SOURCE admits a source archive without original Git history

external_dependencies.name: full parity payloads
external_dependencies.contract: Canonical 6592/live 17347 plus full-game indexes; full preflight must fail on missing/changed data; artifact hosting unresolved

external_dependencies.name: runtime game pack
external_dependencies.contract: version 1 with exact oracle/source identity; externally acquired pack requires independent SHA256; public redistribution unresolved

external_dependencies.name: hosted draft verification
external_dependencies.contract: Python service and explicitly compatible frontend; optional external integration, unavailable in native-only extraction

external_dependencies.name: compatible Python service
external_dependencies.contract: Optional hosted-draft/replay-share verifiers and override metadata exporter require the matching Python backend service sources and its uv.lock environment, including FastAPI/httpx. These are not native runtime dependencies and must not be silently replaced with an incompatible frozen oracle service.

external_dependencies.name: optional Layout Lab import/evaluator
external_dependencies.contract: port_lab_situations.py --lab/--python-src and rollout_parity.py --lab-evaluator explicitly accept external tooling. The Lab backend/state_model modules and evaluator file are excluded, optional and never required or auto-discovered for ordinary native builds/tests. No Lab service is started.

external_dependencies.name: benchmark/profile artifacts
external_dependencies.contract: Full complete-game inputs come from the admitted external fixture cache; arena profiles/starts and perf.data are explicit local inputs. They are separately owned in rust/benchmarks/inputs.json; absence must not become a reduced successful run.

release_blockers: Confirm source/content redistribution rights and attribution.
Publish/acquire all indexed parity payloads and pass full/restore suites.
Run hosted integration with a matching frontend before deployment promotion.
